mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate rises above 4.5% for three consecutive months, it signals aggressive monetary tightening that increases equity discount rates and reduces valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5% for three consecutive months, or Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate deteriorating consumer demand, triggering reduced corporate revenue expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline of HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative SPX returns in more than 60% of cases, or Rank IC for interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-unemployment regime (UNRATE > 7.0%), a decline in the unemployment rate signals labor market improvement that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods with UNRATE > 7.0% and UNRATE decline, SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of cases, or Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) indicates persistent inflation that typically triggers central bank tightening, increasing real interest rates and reducing equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL rises, or Rank IC over 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 600.0 for two consecutive months, it signals a housing sector contraction that reduces consumer wealth and business investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST < 600.0 for two consecutive months, or Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals monetary tightening coinciding with economic weakness, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint movement of FEDFUNDS rising and INDPRO falling fails to predict negative SPX returns in more than 60% of cases, or Rank IC for interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a strong labor market regime (PAYEMS > 130000), a high level of non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals robust job creation that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods with PAYEMS > 130000, SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of cases, or Rank IC is below 0.03.
